statement: SDL PS5 uses L2/R2 analog 8-bit pressure normally, but if analog is zero and corresponding digital L2/R2 button bit is set it forces reported axis to maximum (a compatibility fallback), instead of applying a fixed pressure threshold. Linux maps separate digital BTN_TL2/BTN_TR2 bits directly from button byte. No source establishes a physical L2/R2 digital press threshold in analog counts.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: SDL 535d80b 1188-1199 and 1285-1294; 829a65d 1242-1251,1339-1348; Linux 1489-1492. Source-only consumer policy; no measured mechanical trigger threshold.
